## Updates:
- GP#1991: Improved log display for mod loader installation (by @MovTery)
- GP#1990: Removed update loader/install loader and overwrite installation features & added modify version feature (by @MovTery)
- GP#1994: Added in-game frame rate chart display mode (by @MovTery)
- GP#2027: Main interface now supports adding server cards & removed offline account restrictions (by @MovTery)
- GP#2045: Game requests the highest refresh rate tier at the same resolution, removing the 60fps lock on some devices (by @MovTery)

## Refactors:
- GP#1984: Rewrote background glass blur using Modifier nodes and removed Haze dependency (by @MovTery)
- GP#1990: Refactored OptiFine installation method, added support for combined installation with Forge (by @MovTery)
- GP#2036: Corrected semantics of renderer configuration titles, properly display plugin configuration titles (by @youfeng11, @MovTery)

## Changes:
- GP#1985: Adjusted version card content layout (by @MovTery)
- GP#2035: Adjusted styling of disabled mods in the mod management list (by @MovTery)

## Fixes:
- GP#1984: GIF background stops playing when switching pages (by @MovTery)
- GP#1998: Fixed game input issues with control layout keys and input method character events (by @MovTery)
- GP#2005: Card toolbar promoted to an independent floating layer, fixing buttons not being clickable (by @MovTery)
- GP#1997: Fixed touchpad treating absolute surface coordinates as displacement, causing erratic camera movement in-game (by @MovTery)
- GP#2001: Modpack download failures no longer falsely reported as successful, restored batch retry for failed files (by @MovTery)
- GP#2010: Added missing LWJGL glfwGetWindowPos function (by @MovTery)
- GP#2024: Complete component libraries when installing OptiFine, fixing launch failure due to missing launchwrapper (by @MovTery)
- GP#2025: Possible crash when disabling SDL input method (by @MovTery)
- GP#2026: Downloader failure retry rolled back duplicate byte statistics, fixing progress exceeding task completion (by @MovTery)
- GP#2028: Crash caused by initial window size refresh on background thread during game launch (by @MovTery)
- GP#2029: Control layout quick text input not working on SDL side (by @MovTery)
- GP#2038: Version management ViewModels now follow the version object lifecycle (by @MovTery)
- GP#2041: Fixed TouchController proxy pointer not being released (by @MovTery)

bodies.markdown:
## 更新：
- GP#1991：改良模组加载器安装的日志显示 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1990：移除更新加载器/安装加载器、覆盖安装功能 & 加入修改版本功能 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1994：新增游戏内帧率图表显示模式 (by @MovTery)
- GP#2027：主界面支持新增服务器卡片 & 移除离线账号限制 (by @MovTery)
- GP#2045：游戏请求同分辨率最高刷新率档位，解除部分设备 60fps 锁定 (by @MovTery)


## 重构：
- GP#1984：使用 Modifier 节点重写背景玻璃模糊并移除 Haze 依赖 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1990：重构 OptiFine 安装方式，支持与 Forge 组合安装 (by @MovTery)
- GP#2036：修正渲染器配置项标题的语义，正确显示插件配置的标题 (by @youfeng11、@MovTery)


## 调整：
- GP#1985：调整版本卡片内容布局 (by @MovTery)
- GP#2035：整模组管理列表内已禁用的模组的样式 (by @MovTery)


## 修复：
- GP#1984：切换页面导致 GIF 背景停止播放 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1998：修复控制布局按键与输入法字符事件的游戏输入问题 (by @MovTery)
- GP#2005：卡片工具条提为独立悬浮层，修复按钮无法点击 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1997：修复触控板把板面绝对坐标当作位移导致游戏内视角乱转 (by @MovTery)
- GP#2001：整合包下载失败不再误报成功，恢复失败文件整批重试 (by @MovTery)
- GP#2010：补齐 LWJGL 缺失的 glfwGetWindowPos 函数 (by @MovTery)
- GP#2024：OptiFine 安装时补全组件类库，修复 launchwrapper 缺失导致无法启动 (by @MovTery)
- GP#2025：关闭 SDL 输入法时可能出现的崩溃问题 (by @MovTery)
- GP#2026：下载器失败重试回滚重复字节统计，修复进度超额完成任务 (by @MovTery)
- GP#2028：游戏启动时窗口尺寸初始刷新位于后台线程导致崩溃 (by @MovTery)
- GP#2029：控制布局快捷输入文本在 SDL 端失效 (by @MovTery)
- GP#2038：使版本管理相关 ViewModel 的生命周期跟随版本对象 (by @MovTery)
- GP#2041：修复 TouchController 代理指针无法释放的问题 (by @MovTery)
